from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiabilityReport(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial liability data from a single document."""
    company_name: str = Field(..., description="Name of the company filing the report")
    total_non_current_liabilities: float = Field(..., description="The Total Non-Current Liabilities figure extracted from the document")
    unit_scale: str = Field(..., description="The scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    quote: str = Field(..., description="Verbatim text or table row containing the figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyLiabilityReport]
